title: Story premise ENT052: The Lift to Floor Seven
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (mechanical puzzles). Hook: Up three. Down two. Can we land on seven? Takeaway/theme: Write the actual sequence before calling a route impossible.
description: A toy lift starts at floor 0 and must reach floor 7 using a +3 button and a -2 button, without leaving floors 0 through 9. The operator tries four moves in the order +3, +3, -2, +3, yielding 0, 3, 6, 4, 7; the lift opens to a tiny rooftop garden.
